name: rockett-cad
description: Self-hosted, browser-based parametric CAD for 3D printing (B-Rep kernel, feature timeline)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared --if-present && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.check: run-s lint format:check lint:comments lint:cost lint:writing lint:readme lint:pins lint:notices build test test:browser && sh scripts/check-work-order.sh
scripts.lint:writing: test -f ~/masterrulez/scripts/lint-writing || { echo 'masterrulez lint-writing is missing; clone masterrulez to ~/masterrulez' >&2; exit 1; } && node ~/masterrulez/scripts/lint-writing
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project node --project dom
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p client
